biography: David Rodorigo, a flash of Italian exuberance on the track, hails from the sun-drenched hills of Tuscany. Growing up amidst vineyards and olive groves, young David wasn't initially drawn to the roar of engines. His passion ignited during a local hill climb race, where the raw power and precision of the cars captivated him. He started karting at 15, quickly displaying a natural talent for speed and a fearless overtaking style. His early success led to a spot in the Italian Formula 4 championship, where his aggressive driving earned him both wins and a reputation for pushing the limits. After a stint in Formula Regional, Rodorigo found a home in the Ligier JS2 R series, a perfect fit for his flamboyant personality and skill behind the wheel. Now, at the peak of his career, he eyes the GT world with ambition.
drivingStyle: Rodorigo's driving style is best described as 'controlled chaos.' He's known for his late-braking maneuvers and aggressive corner entries, often pushing the car to its absolute limit. While some criticize his lack of patience, his raw speed and ability to extract maximum performance from the Ligier are undeniable. He has a knack for tire management, especially on long runs, showing surprising maturity when it comes to endurance races, but his weakness is in tricky conditions.

rivalries.name: Isabelle Dubois
rivalries.reason: A constant battle for championship points in the Ligier series. Their contrasting styles – Dubois' calculated precision versus Rodorigo's raw aggression – make for thrilling on-track battles.

rivalries.name: Marco Bellini
rivalries.reason: A fellow Italian driver with whom Rodorigo shares a fierce national pride and a history of karting clashes. Their rivalry is fueled by a desire to be recognized as the top Italian talent.

rivalries.name: Kenji Tanaka
rivalries.reason: Tanaka, a calm Japanese driver, is Rodorigo's opposite in personality. Their conflict stems from a disagreement after a collision caused by Rodorigo's aggressive driving.

quirks: Always wears a lucky charm - a small olive branch pendant - given to him by his grandmother before every race.
Listens to a specific Italian opera aria, 'Nessun Dorma,' as the last thing he does before putting on his helmet.
Refuses to start a race weekend without first enjoying a plate of his mother's homemade pasta carbonara.
famousQuote: "Racing isn't just about speed, it's about passion. It's about feeling the car, pushing the boundaries, and living life on the edge!"
careerHighlight: Winning the Ligier JS2 R championship in 2023 after a season-long battle with Dubois, securing the title with a daring last-lap overtake at Monza.
careerLowPoint: Crashing out of the lead at the 24 Hours of Spa in 2022 due to over-aggression, costing his team a potential podium finish.
